scanNote: 6-mashqdagi rasm uch bo'lakka bo'lib kattalashtirilib sanaldi. Jirafa soni kitobdagi namuna ('three giraffes') bilan aynan mos tushdi — bu sanoqning to'g'riligini tasdiqlaydi. Rasmdagi hayvonlar ataylab noto'g'ri ko'plikli otlardan tanlangan: fish, deer, sheep, mice, geese, oxen.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the animals from Ex. 4 into the correct boxes.
exercises.explanationUz:
4b-MASHQDAGI 11 HAYVON:
  crocodile, duck, dolphin, penguin, ladybird, parrot,
  fly, snake, butterfly, cow, lion

KATAKLAR VA JOY SONI:
  REPTILES — 2 ta
  MAMMALS  — 3 ta
  INSECTS  — 3 ta
  BIRDS    — 3 ta
  Jami: 11 ✓

DIQQAT — CHALG'ITUVCHI HOLATLAR:
  • Pingvin QUSH (ucha olmasa ham — pati va qanoti bor)
  • Delfin SUTEMIZUVCHI (suvda yashasa ham — baliq emas)
  • Kapalak va pashsha HASHAROT (qanoti bo'lsa ham qush emas —
    ularda pat yo'q, olti oyoq bor)

items.hintUz: Suvda va quruqlikda yashaydigan yirik sudralib yuruvchi
items.whyUz: Timsoh — sudralib yuruvchi: tuxum qo'yadi, qanoti yo'q, xavfli.
Ilon — sudralib yuruvchi: tuxum qo'yadi, ba'zilari zaharli.
Delfin bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi → sutemizuvchi.
Sigir — eng aniq sutemizuvchi: sut beradi.
Sher bola tug'adi va sut bilan boqadi → sutemizuvchi.
Xonqizining olti oyog'i bor → hasharot.
Pashshaning olti oyog'i va bir juft qanoti bor → hasharot.

Kapalakning olti oyog'i va ikki juft qanoti bor → hasharot.
Qanoti bor, lekin PATI yo'q — shuning uchun qush emas.
O'rdakda pat, ikki qanot, ikki oyoq bor → qush.

Pingvinda pat, qanot va ikki oyoq bor → QUSH.
Ucha olmasligi uni qush bo'lishdan chiqarmaydi.
To'tiqushda pat, qanot va tumshuq bor → qush.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture and say how many animals you can see, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmga qarang va nechta hayvon ko'rayotganingizni ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: I can see three giraffes.

QOLIP: I can see + son + hayvon (KO'PLIKDA).

RASMDA 8 XIL HAYVON BOR, JAMI 25 TA:
  baliq (fish) ....... 5
  kapalak (butterfly)  4
  sichqon (mouse) .... 4
  jirafa (giraffe) ... 3
  g'oz (goose) ....... 3
  kiyik (deer) ....... 2
  qo'y (sheep) ....... 2
  ho'kiz (ox) ........ 2

DIQQAT — BU MASHQ ATAYLAB TUZILGAN:
sakkiz hayvonning OLTITASI noto'g'ri ko'plikka ega —
fish, deer, sheep, mice, geese, oxen.
Faqat 'giraffes' va 'butterflies' oddiy qoida bo'yicha yasaladi.

items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. 'giraffe' → 'giraffes' (oddiy -s).

Rasmda 5 ta baliq. 'fish' — ko'plikda ham FISH.
'five fishes' XATO.
Rasmda 4 ta kapalak. 'butterfly' → 'butterflies' (undosh + y → ies).

Rasmda 4 ta sichqon. 'mouse' → MICE.
'four mouses' XATO.

Rasmda 3 ta g'oz. 'goose' → GEESE.
'three gooses' XATO.

Rasmda 2 ta kiyik (shoxli, oldindan ko'rinadi). 'deer' → DEER.
'two deers' XATO.

Rasmda 2 ta qo'y. 'sheep' → SHEEP.
'two sheeps' XATO.

Rasmda 2 ta ho'kiz (bo'yinturuqli). 'ox' → OXEN.
'two oxes' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the key and the prompts to make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Kalit va berilgan so'zlardan foydalanib gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KALIT (Key):
  +++  =  very   (juda)
  ++   =  quite  (ancha)

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA: Deer have got quite long legs.
  (deer: ++ long legs → QUITE long legs)

QOLIP:
  Hayvon (ko'plik) + have got + very/quite + sifat + ot.

DIQQAT — BITTA yoki KO'PLIK tana qismi:
  Juft bo'lgan qismlar KO'PLIKDA: legs, ears, eyes, claws, antlers
  Bittalik qismlar 'a' bilan BIRLIKDA: a tail, a trunk
     Elephants have got A very long trunk.
  (Ko'plik shakli ham to'g'ri: ... very long trunkS.)

items.answer: Deer have got quite long legs.
items.whyUz: Kitobda BERILGAN namuna. ++ → QUITE.

items.answer: Deer have got a very short tail.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. Kiyikning dumi juda kalta.

items.answer: Deer have got very big antlers.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. 'antlers' = shoxlar (kiyikning shoxi, doim ko'plikda).

items.answer: Elephants have got a very long trunk.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. Filning xartumi juda uzun (Coursebook 43-bet: 3,1 metr).

items.answer: Elephants have got very big ears.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. Fil quloqlari juda katta — issiqda salqinlatadi.

items.answer: Elephants have got quite big eyes.
items.whyUz: ++ → QUITE. Fil tanasiga nisbatan ko'zi unchalik katta emas.

items.answer: Cats have got quite small ears.
items.whyUz: ++ → QUITE.

items.answer: Cats have got quite big eyes.
items.whyUz: ++ → QUITE. Mushuk ko'zi kechasi ko'rish uchun kattaroq.

items.answer: Cats have got a very long tail.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. Mushuk dumi bilan muvozanat saqlaydi.

items.answer: Koalas have got very sharp claws.
items.whyUz: +++ → VERY. Coursebook 42-betdagi koala matnida ham 'very sharp claws'.

items.answer: Koalas have got quite small eyes.
items.whyUz: ++ → QUITE. Koala ko'zi kichkina, burni esa katta va qora.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME. Work in teams. Use the words in the boxes and take it in turns to make sentences, as in the example. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points wins.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN. Jamoa bo'lib ishlang. Kataklardagi so'zlardan foydalanib, navbat bilan gap tuzing, namunadagidek. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochkoli jamoa yutadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
1-KATAK (hayvonlar):
  dolphins, monkeys, butterflies, penguins, kangaroos,
  crocodiles, cats, tigers, sea lions, dogs

2-KATAK (fe'llar):
  fly, jump, walk, swim, climb

KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  Team A S1: Dolphins can't fly.
  Team B S1: Penguins can swim.

QOLIP:
  Hayvon (ko'plik) + CAN / CAN'T + fe'l (asos shakli).

DIQQAT: 'can' hech qachon -s olmaydi va undan keyin
'to' qo'yilmaydi: 'Dogs can to swim' XATO.

FE'LLAR MA'NOSI:
  fly ..... uchmoq
  jump .... sakramoq
  walk .... yurmoq
  swim .... suzmoq
  climb ... tirmashib chiqmoq

modelSentences.uz: Yo'lbars va suzish (mushuksimonlar ichida kam uchraydi)

modelSentences.sentence: Sea lions can swim very well.

wordFormation.introUz: 25-bet — noto'g'ri ko'plik amaliyoti va daraja so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Oltitasi noto'g'ri, ikkitasi oddiy qoida bo'yicha.
Sifat oldida turadi va uning kuchini ko'rsatadi.
Juft bo'lgan qismlar ko'plikda, yakka qismlar 'a' bilan.

patterns.exampleEn: I can see three giraffes. I can see four mice.
patterns.exampleUz: Men uchta jirafa ko'ryapman. Men to'rtta sichqon ko'ryapman.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sondan keyin ot DOIM ko'plikda.
Noto'g'ri otlarda ko'plik shakli maxsus: mice, geese, oxen, fish, deer, sheep.

patterns.formula: Hayvon (ko'plik) + have got + very/quite + sifat + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: Deer have got quite long legs. Koalas have got very sharp claws.
patterns.exampleUz: Kiyiklarning ancha uzun oyog'i bor. Koalalarning juda o'tkir tirnog'i bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Tartib: have got → very/quite → sifat → ot.

patterns.exampleEn: Dolphins can't fly. Penguins can swim.
patterns.exampleUz: Delfinlar ucha olmaydi. Pingvinlar suza oladi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'can' o'zgarmaydi va undan keyin fe'l asos shaklida ('to' YO'Q).

patterns.exampleEn: Crocodiles and snakes are reptiles. Dolphins, cows and lions are mammals.
patterns.exampleUz: Timsoh va ilon — sudralib yuruvchilar. Delfin, sigir va sher — sutemizuvchilar.
patterns.explanationUz: Sanashda oxirgi so'zdan oldin 'and', qolganida vergul.
